anchor.reuse_rule: reuse only hash-verified exact V1 S1-only checkpoint; otherwise deterministic retrain

decision_dependence.definition: finite centered-logit response under the same anchor-space erasure
decision_dependence.gate: positive candidate-minus-random response with one-sided sign-flip evidence and Holm correction

deployment: S1-only anchor -> legal non-outcome S2 adapter -> held development-subject S3
folds: existing five deterministic development outcome folds; inner four-way subject-disjoint certification

generic.selection: S2 subject-held-out validation within each legal non-outcome training side; no S3 labels

inner_cross_fitting.direction_matching: Hungarian absolute-overlap matching to outer-training basis
inner_cross_fitting.held_data: held inner subjects S2 labels only

outer_command: refused unless EXP4_V2_FINAL_PROTOCOL_LOCK.json exists and status authorizes one-time access

persistence_basis.whiten: pooled covariance inverse square root with ridge 1e-4

primary_endpoint: subject-balanced accuracy on held development S3

statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each fold candidate family; primary Guard-vs-Generic not diluted

utility.positive_gate: mean>0 and one-sided sign-flip/paired evidence with Holm over 8 directions
